Here (NZ) we get no subsidies, pay line charges and only get 50% credit for power we generate. My solution is to use as much of the power I generate during the day and cut usage at night to a bare minimum. I charge my Leaf during the day (free fuel!), do my laundry, dish washing and so on which use most power and only then sell the excess back to the grid. I'm thinking about getting batteries so I can sell even less, or I may be able to use my car battery depending on how complicated the setup for that is. Don't expect a free ride and don't expect the utilities to be pleased you're not using their product more.
